methodologyNotes: Roster covers 12 high-search electric toothbrush models across Oral-B, Philips Sonicare, SURI, quip, Colgate hum, and BURST Oral Care. Specs were re-verified against manufacturer product pages (oralb.com, usa.philips.com, trysuri.com, getquip.com, burstoralcare.com), retailer listings (Amazon, Best Buy, Walmart, Target), and editorial/PR sources (Dezeen, CNN Underscored, PR Newswire, Live Science, TechGearLab, Electric Teeth, newmouth.com, MedGrade, Dental Products Report). Prices are published US MSRP or documented retail as of the access date; priceNote flags sale/MSRP/estimate context. Booleans indicate confirmed presence/absence; null = unverifiable. Battery life expressed in days (manufacturer or third-party figure; multi-month figures converted at ~30 days/month). accessedAt 2026-06-15. Adversarial corrections this pass: Oral-B Pro 1000 cleaning_modes 3->1 (single Daily Clean mode per independent review consensus; current oralb.com relisting claims 3 but the documented product is single-mode); Philips 4100 priceUsd 44.99->49.99 (44.99 was an unsupported midpoint guess; established Philips MSRP is 49.99).

products.name: Oral-B iO Series 10
products.priceNote: MSRP on oralb.com; US retail launch 2023
products.provenance: Price $399.99, 7 Smart Brushing Modes, and Premium Charging Travel Case confirmed on official Oral-B product page (fetched). Pressure sensor, Bluetooth app, and 2-min smart timer are standard iO features. Battery ~14 days (manufacturer 2-week claim). Unveiled at Mobile World Congress Barcelona 2022 (after a CES 2022 preview); US retail availability August 2023 per Amazon/retailer first-available dates. Corroboration title's 'World Mobile Congress' is the source's wording for Mobile World Congress; URL is live and topical.

products.name: Oral-B iO Series 9
products.provenance: Price $329.99 and 7 Smart Brushing Modes (Daily Clean, Whiten, Gum Care, Sensitive, Super Sensitive, Intense, Tongue Clean) confirmed on oralb.com product page (fetched). Power2Go charging travel case confirmed in box contents. Pressure sensor and SmarTimer standard. Battery ~14 days. iO Series 9 launched August 2020 per multiple sources.

products.name: Oral-B iO Series 6
products.provenance: Price $159.99 and 5 Smart Modes (Daily Clean, Whitening, Gum Care, Sensitive, Intense) confirmed on oralb.com product page (fetched); magnetic travel pouch/case included. Bluetooth app and pressure sensor confirmed. Announced at MWC June 2021. Battery ~14 days. (Replaced prior Tech Advisor corroboration link with a live, topical iO6 launch article.)

products.name: Oral-B Pro 1000
products.provenance: CORRECTED cleaning_modes 3->1. The Pro 1000 has a single Daily Clean mode per overwhelming independent review consensus (Live Science, TechGearLab, Electric Teeth, MedGrade): 'only one brushing mode, Daily Clean.' The current oralb.com listing's '3 modes' reflects a merged/relisted SKU, not the documented Pro 1000. Price $49.99 confirmed on oralb.com (fetched). Pressure sensor (stops pulsation when pressed too hard) and 2-minute in-handle timer confirmed. No Bluetooth app, no travel case in box. Battery ~10 days. Exact release year not verifiable -> null.

products.name: Philips Sonicare DiamondClean 9900 Prestige
products.provenance: 5 modes (Clean, White+, Gum Health, Deep Clean, Sensitive) with 3 intensity levels, up to 14-day battery, pressure sensor (light ring), Connected Sonicare/SenseIQ app, BrushPacer/SmarTimer, and USB Prestige charging travel case all confirmed on Philips product page (fetched). Announced January 11 2021, market availability from April 2021 per Philips press release (fetched, valid; no price in release). MSRP $399.99 per retailer listings.

products.name: Philips Sonicare ProtectiveClean 6100
products.provenance: Price $109.95 (suggested retail), 3 modes (Clean, White, Gum Care), up to 2-week battery, pressure sensor (pulsing-sound alert), QuadPacer/SmarTimer, and premium travel case all confirmed on official Philips USA product page (fetched). No Bluetooth app. Launched 2018.

products.name: Philips Sonicare 4100 Series
products.priceNote: Established Philips MSRP; widely on sale ~$40
products.provenance: CORRECTED priceUsd 44.99->49.99. The $44.99 was an unsupported midpoint guess matching no published list price; the established Philips MSRP for the 4100 is $49.99 (official Philips shop price was not displayable this session, so retained the documented MSRP rather than a fabricated midpoint). 1 cleaning mode (Clean) with 2 intensity settings confirmed via Philips/Amazon listings; pressure sensor with auto-intensity reduction confirmed; 2-min SmarTimer + 30-sec QuadPacer; 31,000 strokes/min; up to 14-day battery. No app, no travel case. HX3681 series first available December 2021.

products.name: SURI 2.0 Sustainable Electric Toothbrush
products.priceNote: With UV clean-and-charge travel case; brush only $105
products.provenance: Price $135 (with UV case) / $105 (brush only), 2 modes (clean + polish), Touchsense pressure sensor, 4+ week (~28+ day) battery, 2-minute quadrant timer, and UV-C LED clean-and-charge travel case all confirmed on trysuri.com (fetched). No Bluetooth app. 33,000 sonic vibrations/min. Launched September 3 2025 (US MSRP $135) per Dezeen and CNN Underscored.

products.name: quip Ultra Next Generation Smart Sonic Electric Toothbrush
products.priceNote: MSRP at getquip.com; line starts at $100
products.provenance: Price $110 confirmed on getquip.com (fetched; line starts at $100). 16 customizable brushing intensities confirmed verbatim in PR Newswire launch release (fetched); getquip markets this as '10+ intensities.' Up to 30-day battery at medium intensity, pressure sensor with light/pulse alerts, Bluetooth quip app, 2-min timer with 30-sec pulses, and travel case (+counter stand, mirror mount) all confirmed. Announced February 5 2025. (Updated source.url to a live getquip Ultra product page.)

products.name: Colgate hum Smart Electric Toothbrush (Rechargeable)
products.priceNote: MSRP; kit includes brush, heads, charger, travel case
products.provenance: Rechargeable MSRP $69.99 confirmed in Colgate PR Newswire release (fetched; battery-powered variant $49.99). 3 sonic modes (Normal, Sensitive, Deep Clean) confirmed via release and newmouth.com. ~10-day battery. hum by Colgate Bluetooth app and 2-min timer/quadpacer confirmed. Travel case included in kit. No pressure sensor (tracks frequency/coverage, not pressure). Announced August 17 2020, available September 2020.

products.name: BURST Pro Sonic Toothbrush
products.priceNote: Launch MSRP per press release; current retail ~$69.99
products.provenance: Launch MSRP $79.99, 5 modes (Whitening, Clean, Sensitivity, Freshen, Massage), and up to 9-month (~270-day) battery confirmed in PR Newswire October 3 2023 release (fetched, valid). Pressure feedback scoring (pressure sensor) confirmed; 2-min timer with quad intervals. No Bluetooth app. Travel case not in standard kit (sold separately). Launched October 3 2023.

products.name: BURST Pro 2.0 Sonic Toothbrush
products.provenance: Price $79.99 (sale, reg. $120.99), 5 modes (Whitening, Clean, Massage, Sensitive, Freshen), up to 9-month (~270-day) battery, smart pressure sensor, and 2-minute timer all confirmed on burstoralcare.com (fetched). No Bluetooth app. Magnetic wall mount included; travel case sold separately ($14.99). Released 2025 per MedGrade review and Amazon first-available date.
